name: @wxyc/auth-user-name-backfill
description: One-shot backfill: rewrite auth_user.name to the on-air handle (or username) it should always have held, so the column stops being a hidden second copy of the legal name (DJ real-name PII safeguards plan, Track 2d). Opens with a machine-enforced precondition gate that refuses to run until Track 2a's preserve-first copy (name -> real_name) has run. Dry-run by default; --execute to write. ~139 candidate rows, single SELECT-all.
